evidence: Sentinel-2 tight chip (1.5 km buffer) at 26.2164, -97.6281 on 2020-01-15 shows agricultural fields with irrigation ditches, no industrial construction (imagery/s2_2020-01_tight.png)

Sentinel-2 tight chip on 2026-07-01 shows the same tract still in agricultural use, some fields fallow/tilled, no laydown yard, no cranes, no turbine hall, no cooling structures, no substation pad (imagery/s2_2026-07_tight.png)

Sentinel-2 wide 6 km chip on 2026-07-01 confirms the surrounding area is farmland between Harlingen and San Benito with no industrial CCGT footprint anywhere near the coordinates (imagery/s2_2026-07-01.png)
GEM Wiki, sourcing EIA-860M, records the 1,282 MW unit CC1 at these coordinates as Shelved and a companion 771 MW unit CC_set as Cancelled (sources/2026-07-18_gemwiki_lapaloma-energy-center.html)
13 years have elapsed since the planned 2013 construction start and 11 years since the planned 2015 COD in the original TCEQ permit application; nothing has been built

reasoning_evidence: The 2027-07-30 reported COD is a queue field with no contractual grounding: no signed Interconnection Agreement is on file (iaSigned null across all 24 monthly snapshots), no financial security has been posted with ERCOT (financialSecurityAndNoticeToProceedProvided = No), and the FIS has been requested but not approved for 24 months
The PUCT TEF loan (App-162) was denied 2024-09-04 for failing due-diligence, with the denial not subject to motions for rehearing or appeal (sources/2026-07-18_puct_TEF_denial_pressrelease.pdf)

Aegle CEO Kathleen Smith's 2017 embezzlement conviction (Chase Power, SDTX) and the fraud-adjacent misuse of NextEra's name make a lender-backed FID for a 1.5 GW project essentially impossible in the near term

The same physical site was permitted in 2012 under a different LLC (La Paloma Energy Center LLC / Coronado Power Ventures) for 637-735 MW with a planned COD of 2015-10-01; construction never began and both historical units are recorded as Shelved/Cancelled per EIA-860M

Aegle's current 1,536 MW claim is roughly double the 637-735 MW that was actually permitted at TCEQ in 2012; any credible restart would require a new or amended TCEQ NSR permit - no such active permit found under the Aegle Power name
13 years of ground truth via Sentinel-2 shows the FM 1595 tract has never been developed and remains agricultural in the latest 2026-07 imagery

contractual_schedule.note: NO signed IA on file. PUCT Interchange returned HTTP 402 in triage; no IA filing surfaced under Aegle Power in Brave search. The only permit-like document on file for this site is the historical 2012 TCEQ/EPA GHG PSD air permit application under a different LLC (La Paloma Energy Center LLC / Coronado Power Ventures), for a smaller 637-735 MW plant, with a planned 2015 COD that was never achieved.
